name: Swedish Championship 2017
information:
Official Swedish Championships in all WCA events.
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome. The best placed swedish competitor in each event becomes swedish champion.
The participation fee has been set to 150SEK.
The maximum number of participants is 150. If that is reached a waiting list will be created.
Registration will close on May 19 or when the competitor limit is reached.
For more information go to the competition website.
